findings.title: The legal disclosure contains conflicting correct and incorrect company-name grammar
findings.quality_lens: The same legal page publishes both an incorrect and a correct legal-entity phrase.
findings.system_lens: Legal disclosure content appears duplicated without a shared validated source or editorial acceptance gate.
findings.business_lens: A visible error in a legal and trust-building section can reduce confidence during vendor due diligence.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm both variants are visible in settled desktop and mobile renders. Do not infer legal invalidity.

findings.title: A dated pricing article presents an expired campaign as an immediate future action
findings.quality_lens: An article dated October 2025 says a May 2025 change will occur and urges action before April 2025.
findings.system_lens: Time-sensitive commercial copy lacks expiry-aware rendering, archival labeling, or freshness validation.
findings.business_lens: Expired urgency on a pricing journey can confuse buyers and weaken trust in current commercial terms.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm current pricing and the expired call-to-action are visibly rendered; final severity requires archive-context review.

findings.title: The developer partner page labels two materially different models as Integrator
findings.quality_lens: Two different partner journeys use the same Integrator label while describing opposite earning and support models.
findings.system_lens: Partner type, responsibility, support ownership, and revenue entitlement are not expressed as a clear typed taxonomy.
findings.business_lens: Prospective partners may misunderstand which operating model generates revenue and who supports the client.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the duplicate labels and contrasting descriptions in desktop and mobile; human review must account for visual grouping.

findings.title: Core commercial and developer pages contain visible language-quality defects
findings.quality_lens: Public acquisition pages expose case-agreement, sentence-structure, and terminology defects.
findings.system_lens: Commercial and developer publishing lacks a consistent language-quality acceptance gate.
findings.business_lens: Copy defects on CRM and API positioning pages can reduce perceived product and integration maturity.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm exact wording is visible in settled desktop and mobile, not only present in source markup.
